HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
